analysis_scope: Explore differences in predictive benefit across the four existing task heads. Reuse historical paired-user AUC implementation and q4 draws. Retain all effects and contrasts, regardless of sign.
interval_policy: 95% percentile paired-user intervals, exploratory and descriptive; no multiplicity or selection correction, equivalence or only-one-task conclusion. Conditional on these checkpoints, not training-seed variation.
bce_definition: Convert stored probability to float64; clip at original prediction dtype epsilon; use log and log1p. Aggregate resampled user loss sums divided by actual resampled row count; task BCE scales differ.
q4_replay: Exact historical per-task and macro AUC intervals required; save draws to recover task covariance.
interpretation_boundary: Repeated processing of fixed input can expose predictive signal previously unused by a task. This analysis does not measure literal new external information or establish the mechanism.
